questions.reason: The captured overview states verbatim that "Managed MLflow in Nebius AI Cloud enables you to access model artifacts, training results, and tuned hyperparameters in a single interface", which establishes option b and contradicts the separate-dashboard, auto-selection and hyperparameters-only distractors.

The training section says the `--policy.type=act` policy "will automatically adapt to the number of motor states, motor actions and cameras of your robot (e.g. `wrist` and `top`) which have been saved in your dataset" — and the page records those features into the dataset at creation — so only option a stands; the page describes no manual feature, calibration or `accelerate config` step for this adaptation.

The multi-GPU page states "**LeRobot does not auto-scale the learning rate or the number of steps** when the effective batch size grows. If you scale out and want equivalent training, please adjust manually", which supports option a and rules out every automatic-adjustment distractor.
